# Maheshwaran A K

> AI-native full-stack engineer in Salem, Tamil Nadu, India. React and
> TypeScript on the front, FastAPI and Node behind, Postgres and MySQL
> underneath. Also written as A K Maheshwaran and Maheshwaran K.

Currently at Bipolar Factory, building the product layer around retail-analytics
AI systems. Previously founded Statix.pro and took its products 0 to 1.
3+ years shipping production software. Available for full-time roles and
freelance contracts, remote only, from India Standard Time (UTC+5:30).

Builds multi-tenant systems with role-based access control, configurable
approval workflow engines, enterprise ERP software, retail-analytics and KPI
dashboards, and LLM and AI-agent integrations.

## Pages

- [Portfolio](https://maheshwaran.dev/): Work history, selected projects, stack and contact details.
- [What I build](https://maheshwaran.dev/work/): The work grouped by problem rather than by project — multi-tenant systems with role-based access control and configurable approval workflows; retail-analytics and operational dashboards; LLM and AI-agent integration. Each group states who it is for and links to the shipped evidence.
- [Institutional Finance & Research Platform](https://maheshwaran.dev/work/institutional-platform/): Case study on a multi-tenant ERP running budgeting, expenditure and settlement for a 39-department institution — 330+ active users, ₹43.4 Cr of budget processed, 14+ months in production.
- [Land2Build — case study](https://maheshwaran.dev/work/land2build/): A browser-only construction planner. An LLM parses the brief into a typed config; a deterministic binary space partition generates the floor plan, so the layout carries testable invariants — rooms stay in bounds and never overlap, checked across randomised runs.
- [Guide2Profit — post-mortem](https://maheshwaran.dev/work/guide2profit/): Why a well-built financial-modelling SaaS found no market — founders delegate financial modelling rather than doing it themselves. Built with a friend, whose idea it was; shelved in 2024.
- [Résumé](https://maheshwaran.dev/resume/): Full work history, selected projects, stack and credentials as a page. The same content as a file: [PDF](https://maheshwaran.dev/Maheshwaran-A-K-Resume.pdf).
- [Changelog](https://maheshwaran.dev/changelog/): Every change to this site, read from its git history at build time.
